allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. Pre-2.0 P2-REPLAY-COST (withdrawn replay-economics claim, sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b) warned against promoting scripted replay as real-agent economics; that guard is carried forward here by requiring honest retrieval/verification/repair counters and a known-negative refusal rather than a headline speed number. P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION (sha 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda) is the pre-2.0 ancestor of parameterized composition. This allocation does not re-measure economics (blocked at ceiling); it installs an already-audited live carrier at a frozen identity and certifies executable/refusal behaviour, which no archived artifact did -- a materially distinct extension, not a rerun of the excluded fourth REST certificate.
allocation.question: Can the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier be installed byte-identically at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py with a binding pre-freeze positive/negative certificate -- (a) positive: distill_parameterized over >=3 induction observations -> resolve EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action at confidence 0.9 -> deterministic fixture execute status 200 -> verify true on an UNSEEN held-out identifier; (b) negative: refuse out-of-support / missing-parameter / wrong-intent bindings with a recorded reason and a null bound action, returning exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN for the no-applicable-mechanism case; (c) honest inherited-path counters (retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts); (d) installed identity equal to the frozen carrier git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 -- such that promotion is enabled ONLY on independent audit PASS, discharging blocker B1?
allocation.rationale: Product's last packet (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440) adopted a bounded substrate-class negative: on the mandatory-discovery deterministic credential-free REST class both comparator arms sit at the 1.0 correctness ceiling, so the frozen cost/novelty test has no dynamic range and a fourth re-run is explicitly excluded. The parent C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY four-arm benchmark therefore cannot be honestly funded until its prerequisites exist. B1 -- a shipped Product treatment that demonstrates a pre-freeze executable inherited parameterized mechanism plus a known-negative refusal at the frozen carrier identity -- is the first prerequisite and is directly addressable now, independently of Physics or Frontier. Installing the audited carrier and certifying it before freeze is the cheapest action that converts an audited research capability into a promotable product surface, and it respects the two-factory boundary because it does not require the benchmark to run.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Cycle 38168973103, 436 canonical Research-2.0 packets. Effective epistemic state: C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED at a bounded authorship-separated ceiling; every other live claim is EXPERIMENTAL or HYPOTHESIS. The dominant program-level fact is not a shortage of hypotheses but a recurring class of design/substrate defects (empty sampling frames, code-bound-into-freeze unsatisfiability, byte-identical or provably-identical control arms, mis-specified stability gates, unattainable numeric targets, ceiling effects) that convert CONFIG into MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED: 16/60 recent audits are MEASUREMENT_INVALID, 13/60 REVISE, and only C-MEAS-VALID, C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR have any accepted R2 event above HYPOTHESIS. The flagship four-arm inheritance benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER) is correctly NOT funded this cycle because none of the three readiness conditions holds in accepted evidence: B1 (shipped Product treatment demonstrating a pre-freeze executable inherited parameterized mechanism plus a known-negative refusal), B2 (task bank with non-ceiling cold/retrieval baselines and a treatment/comparator distinction), B3 (a same-model endpoint able to drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent test under budget). All six lanes hold a correct unfinished PREFREEZE experiment and none is frozen, so I CONTINUE all six: product removes B1, runtime removes B2, intel tests B3, while graph, physics and frontier each remove a decisive validity blocker on a core claim (C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE de-confounding, C-WEB-DYNAMICS cross-vantage transfer, C-CROSSSITE deep-item attainability). No lane is idle, stalled or duplicating an archived experiment, so no PARK/TERMINATE is warranted; the highest-value use of this cycle is to let the three readiness-blocker lanes finish and to force the other three lanes' pruned control-plane defects to be fixed at freeze rather than re-discovered as MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: Scout ran in DEGRADED mode (rc=139; empty spider_evidence and external_directional_context) and offered no external competitor, dataset or baseline, so it contributed nothing that changes a SPIDER decision and I did not treat its fallback list as evidence. Its candidate_directions are re-statements of the lanes' own parent handoffs plus generic 'reassess' prompts, which I independently re-derived from the snapshot rather than accepting. What was useful was its framing: it flagged all six lanes as PREFREEZE and asked (a) which blocker most constrains the residual-novelty claim, (b) which lanes repeat repair work whose prerequisite should be fixed once in Runtime/Product, and (c) what each lane would investigate with no parent handoff. I answered (b) by keeping Runtime on the shared B2 substrate and Product on the shared B1 carrier rather than letting either chase its local claim; because Scout is degraded, no new Intel reconnaissance mandate was created to chase an unverified external lead.
